passage.label: Ali 'Imran — Those who disbelieve in Allah's signs and kill prophets without right and kill those who enjoin justice among people: give tidings of painful punishment; their deeds ruined in dunya and akhirah; no helpers for them; have you not seen those given portion of scripture invited to Allah's Book to judge between them then a party turns away refusing; because they say Fire won't touch us except numbered days; deluded in religion by fabrications; how when We gather them for Day no doubt; each soul paid in full what it earned; not wronged

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيۡرِ حَقّٖ وَيَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَبَشِّرۡهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتۡ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ نَصِيبٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَحۡكُمَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ وَهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَالُواْ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامٗا مَّعۡدُودَٰتٖۖ وَغَرَّهُمۡ فِي دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
فَكَيۡفَ إِذَا جَمَعۡنَٰهُمۡ لِيَوۡمٖ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ وَوُفِّيَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ

mainSubject.label: Triple crime condemnation: disbelief in signs, unjust killing of prophets, killing justice-enforcers; painful punishment announced; total nullification of deeds in both worlds; absence of any helpers; People of Scripture turning away from divine arbitration despite being invited; false security doctrine ('Fire only numbered days') identified as fabrication-based delusion; eschatological confrontation: inevitable gathering on undoubted Day; complete individual compensation without injustice
